# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series; dies at sixty-four.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased (suffered a fatal heart attack from sudden shock).  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband (used by Avonlea people to refer to his brother-in-law Thomas, while Matthew himself is Marilla's brother)  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and long iron-gray hair touching his shoulders. He wore a full, soft brown beard continuously since he was twenty years old. Though stooped, he had a shy, kindly face and gentle brown eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Matthew was extraordinarily shy and silent, dreading strangers and particularly all women except his sister Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Despite his painful shyness, he had a deeply gentle, sympathetic, and indulgent nature. He was a quiet listener who appreciated lively chatter when no response was demanded of him, and he silently clung to his opinions with surprising persistence.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)_

## Traits

- Painfully shy and silent  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Fear of strangers and women  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Quietly persistent  <sub>[v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c19 P23](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0023)</sub>
- Indulgent and generous  <sub>[v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and manual labor  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c24 P16](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep Green Gables running smoothly and adopt a boy to assist with farmwork  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To love, protect, and indulge Anne Shirley in every way possible  <sub>[v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet, secluded life farming Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Reaching the age of sixty and suffering from heart trouble, he agreed with Marilla to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work. When Matthew drove to Bright River station to collect the child, he was met by Anne Shirley instead, whom he lacked the heart to turn away. During the drive home, he was instantly charmed by her imaginative chatter and convinced Marilla to let her stay at Green Gables. Over the next four years, Matthew became Anne's steadfast champion and 'kindred spirit,' frequently indulging her wishes, buying her chocolate sweeties, insisting she be allowed to attend social events, and purchasing a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves for her Christmas gift. He took immense pride in her academic achievements, encouraging her dreams and assuring her he was prouder of her than a dozen boys. In her second year of teaching, when Anne passed her entrance examinations to Queen's Academy at the top of the Island, Matthew expressed his deep pride in her. Shortly after her graduation, Matthew received a newspaper reporting the sudden collapse of the Abbey Bank where all his and Marilla's savings were kept; the shock caused an instantaneous, fatal heart attack in the doorway of Green Gables.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 c19 P18](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0018), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Son of the man who original founded the Green Gables homestead far back from the main road  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Lived his whole life at Green Gables with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Suffered from long-standing heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)</sub>
